user.title: Set up Ampère
user.description: Ampère tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add a parcel afterwards from the integration's Configure menu.

reauth_confirm.title: Ampère session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Ampère no longer accepts one of this hub's stored tracking sessions. Confirm to reconnect using the tracking link this parcel was originally added with — no need to dig up the e-mail again. If it's not obvious which parcel that is, a picker appears below so you can say which one.

error.invalid_link: The stored tracking link for this parcel no longer works. Remove the parcel and add it again with a fresh link from a new e-mail.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Ampère. Please try again.

abort.no_parcels: This hub has no tracked parcels to reconnect.

add_parcel.title: Track a parcel
add_parcel.description: Paste the tracking link from that parcel's own shipping-confirmation e-mail from bol.com.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks Ampère for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on Ampère's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

abort.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked, in this hub or another one.
abort.no_parcels: This hub has no tracked parcels to remove.

error.invalid_link: That tracking link was rejected — it may be malformed, already used up or expired. Open the original e-mail and copy the link again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Ampère. Please try again.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked, in this hub or another one.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
